name: describes a photographed storefront and reports the text on its sign
input:
storefront-dusk.png

Extracted scene: a shop front photographed at dusk. A neon sign above the door reads OPEN LATE. A chalkboard on the pavement lists espresso 3.20 and pastries 2.40. Two people stand under the awning.

assertions.why: a .png routed to the audio stage is asked for a transcription of a photograph
text in the frame belongs in the field the image schema declares for it, which is what a search index over storefronts reads
labels are what a catalogue filters on; a description alone leaves nothing to filter by
